programme.title: JMC Broadcasting - The Salt Lie The Vaccine Truth and the Glyphosate Cover-Up

They told you salt is bad for you Then they pumped 9000mg of it into your veins in the hospital and charged 800 a bag

He exposes USAIDs role in funding gain-of-function research through EcoHealth Alliance to the Wuhan Institute of Virology—but warns its not just China England and other countries have been developing biological weapons too And he questions why Senator Rand Paul who grills Fauci on perjury never asks about remdesivir—a drug his wife invested in just months before it was mandated
The glyphosate cover-up is exposed Bayer owns Monsanto The Supreme Court just blocked cancer victims from suing Glyphosate destroys copper and zinc in the soil—creating zinc deficiency which fuels cancer and estrogen dominance and copper deficiency which drives diabetes dementia and heart disease The pharmaceutical giants created the problem and sell the solution
